questions.label: Why do you want to join the technical team for ACM-W specifically? What caught your eye about our club?
The Tech Stack: What languages, frameworks, or tools do you usually like to build with?
Show Your Work: Drop a link to a project you are proud of (GitHub repo, live website, or portfolio). What part of it did you actually build?

What You Can Do: If you join the team, what kind of stuff do you actually want to help us build?
